author: Bellular News
description:
Battlefield 6 has become one of EA’s record performers, while its roadmap and current reporting point towards a much longer future than players expected.

We break down how Battlefield proved its live-service plan could work, what its development timeline reveals, and why keeping a game truly “live” takes more than simply announcing another season. All while EA cuts jobs amid record profits.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of Loading Screen every month, and to support our team!
